test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pianos are guitars.

All guitars are flutes.

**Conclusion:**

I) Some pianos are flute.

II) No guitar is a piano.

options.text: Both Conclusions I and II follow.
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given Statements:

Some pianos are guitars.

All guitars are flutes.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d36cd4a8702d4864275cd0569183b99cb99921847ac19a1726d4326bb02de6d6.png] 

Conclusion:

I) Some pianos are flute - True (Some pianos are guitars and all guitars are flutes implies that some pianos are flute)

II) No guitar is a piano - False (Some pianos are guitars implies also that some guitars are definitely piano)

So, only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
